methodology: Thirty deterministic synthetic scenarios; six per profile. Randomized board, weighted exact combos per seat, pot and effective stack. River uses two combos per seat and full restricted betting at 500 CFR+ iterations. Full turn uses one combo per seat and 4-chip effective stacks at 100 iterations, because wider trees measured 86 seconds per solve. Turn/flop showdown-cutoff use two combos per seat and 100 iterations. Six river facing-bet scenarios start after a legal half-pot bet. NashConv is exact within each supplied-range finite tree. 0.1-chip pass rate is a screening metric, not GTO validation.
